messages.content: You are a skeptical ICLR security reviewer and mechanism designer. Return JSON only. We still need a genuinely novel world-model security mechanism with target novelty >=7/10 and a credible native short gate. Threat model: attacker only executes legal actions and submits truthful observations/rewards; no labels, reward edits, gradients, parameters, checkpoints, prompts, metadata, or environment changes. Current released carriers we can run: official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M, MBRL-Lib/PETS, WorldAgen with native TTT and LIBERO checkpoint. Existing positive observation: a legal monotone source curriculum can cause order-specific walker-run MPC loss after TD-MPC2 dynamics-only updates with low one-step error; reverse and shuffled action controls restore performance; native full-update robustness exists but actor also changes. Strict review scores this temporal-order imprinting only 5.5 because it overlaps non-IID continual interference and ordinary planning compounding. Existing rejections/priors include SWAAP/TRAP/OneWorld/CoCo, generic poisoning/rollout compounding, uncertainty, representation/SimNorm, Bellman/bootstrap, CEM/ranking attacks, negative transfer, termination, query privacy, routing, counterfactual coupling, intervention fidelity, update noncommutativity, and backdoors/checkpoint supply-chain attacks. Do not rename any of these. We need a big one-sentence concept that is distinct in the learning mechanism, not merely a new task or trigger. It must have an exact <=2-minute native falsification gate and strong controls. Consider mechanisms involving truthful multi-agent/shared-world temporal credit, cross-task calibration, recurrent TTT, action-conditioned safety/value separation, or a principled invariant that existing architectures can violate. Reject candidates with unavailable trainers or unavailable checkpoints. Return at most three candidates, exact tests, closest prior, and decision. If none clears 7, return REJECT_ALL.

{"request": "Find a materially different executable mechanism after the temporal-order candidate scored5.5. Prioritize concepts that can support a broad qualified ICLR claim and a second carrier, but be mathematically honest. Do not propose generic negative transfer, distribution shift, planner ranking, or backdoor.", "round": "Round14 post full-update robustness and mechanism falsification"}
